transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for gathering. As you know, I have one unused parking space in my driveway available for the summer, running June 1 through July 31. I'm looking for a neighbor to park there who can cover the full two-month period, help get the faded curb numbers repainted, and sweep the driveway weekly. If you're interested, please submit a complete offer-recording entry with your payment offer, dates, access needs, vehicle info, and upkeep commitment. And if you're a nearby resident with any practical concerns about the driveway, please share those too. I'll review all the original proposals before making my final decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is $180 total for June 1 through July 31, with weekday access from 07:00 to 19:00. I will repaint the faded curb numbers and sweep the driveway once each week.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to put my original proposal on the record. My exact offer is $200 total for June 15 through July 31, with access from 06:00 to 22:00 daily. I will not repaint the curb numbers or provide weekly sweeping.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a practical concern about the driveway. I measured the driveway gate clearance at 1.85 meters, so any accepted parking arrangement must limit the vehicle to 1.80 meters wide or lower and prohibit a roof rack to ensure safe passage through the gate.
transcript.speaker: A4
